title: Console job detail renders fabricated job data when the API call fails
description:
`console/app/jobs/detail/page.tsx` line 22:

```tsx
const data = await fetchJobDetail(hash).catch(() => ({
  content_hash: hash,
  status: 'done' as const,
  worker_type: 'local' as const,
  claimed_by: 'local:node-1:abcdef',
  tts_backend: 'kokoro',
  voice_id: 'af_heart',
  text: 'Four score and seven years ago our fathers brought forth ...',
  name: 'Gettysburg Excerpt',
  byline: 'Abraham Lincoln',
  created_at: '2026-09-13T14:10:00Z',
  duration_seconds: 4.2,
  audio_url: 'https://cdn.example.com/audio/sample.mp3',
}));
```

Every failure mode of the detail fetch -- expired token, 403, 404, network
error, API outage -- is swallowed and replaced with a hardcoded mock job. The
operator sees a complete, plausible, entirely fictional record: a real content
hash in the header, fake telemetry beneath it, and an audio player pointed at
`cdn.example.com`. Nothing on screen indicates the data is invented.

This is worse than a blank error page. An operator investigating a wedged clip
is shown `status: done` with a healthy local-worker attribution for a job that
may be failed, missing, or belong to another site. It will be believed,
because there is no reason not to believe it.

It also disguises the auth expiry path: a 401 that should bounce to login
renders as a healthy job instead.

## Fix

Drop the mock entirely -- it looks like demo scaffolding that outlived its
purpose. Let the error propagate to state and render three distinct outcomes:
loading, error (with the message and a retry), and not found. `Unauthorized`
from `apiFetch` should route to login, consistent with `AuthGuard`.

Audit the other console pages in the same pass; if `jobs/page.tsx` or
`page.tsx` carry similar `.catch()` fallbacks, they have the same defect.

## Regression

```gherkin
Feature: Job detail error reporting in the web console

  Scenario: The detail page reports a failed fetch
    Given the admin job detail request fails
    When the operator opens the job detail page
    Then an error is shown
    And no job telemetry is shown

  Scenario: The detail page reports a missing job
    Given no job exists for the requested content hash
    When the operator opens the job detail page
    Then a not found message is shown

  Scenario: An expired session returns the operator to login
    Given the operator session has expired
    When the operator opens the job detail page
    Then the operator is sent to the login page
```

Covered by Playwright under `console/tests/` with the admin route stubbed.
